post.hook: Six AI stories that matter today.
post.tiktok: Anthropic's $60B chip money, Cloudflare's new models, and a ChatGPT Mac flaw. Today's top 6 in AI 👇
post.facebook: Today in AI: Broadcom lines up $60B for Anthropic's chips, Cloudflare launches Clef, and a ChatGPT Mac flaw gets patched.

voice.text: This is AI DR, your AI news for Friday, October second.
Six stories today. Here's what matters.

stories.headline: *Open-weight decision models*, now on Workers AI

voice.text: Cloudflare is launching Clef, open-weight decision models on Workers AI.
Plus a new platform to fine-tune them with reinforcement learning, on your own data.

stories.headline: Models that manage *their own context* as a file

voice.text: In research, Context Language Models manage their own context as a file.
And they beat state-of-the-art context management on BrowseComp-Plus and EdgeBench.
Microsoft AI has released MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming, for real-time transcription, expanding its voice agent lineup.

stories.headline: *$60B credit facility* to fund AI chips

voice.text: Broadcom is lining up a sixty billion dollar credit facility to fund AI chips for Anthropic and its peers.
All as Anthropic eyes a November twenty-sixth IPO, valued at up to two trillion dollars.

stories.headline: The AI music maker now speaks

voice.text: Suno now generates spoken word. Voiceovers and background music together, in public beta on web and mobile.

stories.headline: A patched flaw could have *leaked sensitive data*

voice.text: And a patched flaw in ChatGPT's Mac app could have let hackers grab sensitive data.
A reminder that AI software is a target too.
That's AI DR for today. Every story, ranked and summarized, at aidr dot today.
